data.name: Guillotine
data.detailed_description:
DON'T TRUST ANYONE

Guillotine is an online medieval social deduction game where every match is full of lies, suspicion, and difficult decisions.

Use magic, complete your tasks, protect your secret role, and find the real culprit before it's too late.

But be careful...Sometimes the loudest voice is the guilty one.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CAST SPELLS

Instead of pressing simple buttons, players use drawing gestures to cast spells, do tasks and Kill!.

Your actions can make other players trust you... or suspect you.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FIND THE CULPRIT

Some players want to protect the village.

Others want to secretly destroy it.

Watch how people move.

Listen to what they say.

Find the liar before your team makes the wrong decision.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

EVERY VOTE MATTERS

Talk with your team.

Defend yourself.

Accuse other players.

Then vote.

One wrong vote can change the whole game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BUILT-IN VOICE CHAT

No extra programs are needed.

Talk with your friends directly inside the game.

Discuss, argue, lie, or tell the truth.

Communication is part of the gameplay.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Guillotine is made for groups of friends. It can be played from 4 to 16 players

Every match creates different stories, funny moments, unexpected betrayals, and memorable victories.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FEATURES

  • Online Multiplayer

  • Social Deduction Gameplay

  • Built-in Voice Chat

  • Drawing-Based Spell System

  • Medieval Fantasy Setting

  • Hidden Roles

  • Team Discussions

  • Voting System

  • Unique Spells

  • Replayable Matches
